# A server limit, first as a NO that leaves the connection usable, then
# as a BYE after which the server hangs up.
S: * OK [CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1] ready
C: A1 UID FETCH 1 (BODY.PEEK[])
S: A1 NO [OVERQUOTA] Account exceeded command or bandwidth limits. (Failure)
C: A2 UID FETCH 1 (BODY.PEEK[])
S: * BYE [ALERT] Download bandwidth limit exceeded
